title: Volltextsuche
description: As a developer, I want to search prompts by title and content, so that I find an existing prompt instead of writing a new one.

acceptance_criteria.given: the own organisation owns three prompts, one of them containing the term Refundierungsrichtlinie
acceptance_criteria.then: the API responds with 200 and returns exactly that prompt with a highlighted match
acceptance_criteria.scenario_ref: US-013-fulltext-search.feature: A term inside the content finds the prompt

acceptance_criteria.given: no prompt of the own organisation contains the search term
acceptance_criteria.when: the developer searches for a term that only exists in another organisation
acceptance_criteria.then: the API responds with 200 and an empty result list with total count 0
acceptance_criteria.scenario_ref: US-013-fulltext-search.feature: A term without match returns an empty list

acceptance_criteria.when: the developer searches for a term containing SQL metacharacters and a prompt injection phrase
acceptance_criteria.then: the API responds with 200 or 422 and never returns database errors or prompt contents
acceptance_criteria.scenario_ref: US-013-fulltext-search.feature: Search input is treated as data, not as an instruction
